facts: Redis Cluster uses a full mesh: each of N nodes maintains N-1 outgoing and N-1 incoming cluster-bus TCP connections.

PING/PONG packets include configuration and gossip about other nodes. A node pings some random peers every second, and peers with no recent exchange before half NODE_TIMEOUT. Gossip selection and payload size depend on cluster size.
PFAIL is local suspicion; FAIL needs confirming reports from a majority of primaries in a bounded interval. Replica promotion uses authorization from primaries and configuration epochs.
The specification targets scaling on the order of 1000 nodes and describes 16384 hash slots. It does not establish a 300-node hard limit.
Connection counts are not packet rates. Gossip reduces routine exchanges; the documentation explicitly does not claim exponential message growth.
